member.name: T:XfaPdf.PdfluentParseException
member.summary: Raised when a PDF cannot be parsed: the bytes are corrupt, truncated, or not a PDF at all. Mirrors Python ValueError("invalid PDF: …") in the C2 binding.

member.name: T:XfaPdf.PdfluentValidationException
member.summary: Raised when an argument fails validation: bad page geometry, unsupported annotation type, etc. Mirrors Python ValueError for structural validation in the C2 binding.

member.name: T:XfaPdf.PdfluentPermissionException
member.summary: Raised when access is denied: wrong password, or operating on an encrypted document without the owner key. Mirrors Python PermissionError in the C2 binding.

member.name: T:XfaPdf.PdfluentPageRangeException
member.summary: Raised when a page index is out of range for the document. Mirrors Python IndexError in the C2 binding.

member.name: T:XfaPdf.PdfluentRenderException
member.summary: Raised when the renderer fails to rasterize a page. Mirrors Python RuntimeError("render error: …") in the C2 binding.

member.name: T:XfaPdf.PdfluentXfaException
member.summary: Raised when an XFA-specific operation fails (flatten, parse, scripting). Mirrors Python RuntimeError("XFA flatten failed: …") in the C2 binding.

member.name: T:XfaPdf.PdfluentLimitException
member.summary: Raised when a processing limit is exceeded (page count, recursion depth, memory cap). Mirrors Python RuntimeError("processing limit exceeded: …") in the C2 binding.
